segments.heading: 2 / Cancel A; start B
segments.body: Request cancellation and wait for the controller's acknowledgement. Mark A as CANCELLED / REPLACED, then send B with a distinct command ID.
segments.proof: Acknowledgement is a protocol event. It does not mean the joints instantly reached zero velocity.

segments.heading: Result / B owns the outcome
segments.body: The arm has reached B, not A. B is declared successful only after its own measured settling checks. The old goal cannot complete the new Future.
segments.proof: Recorded outcomes: A = CANCELLED (REPLACED); B = SUCCEEDED.
